Auditor
Chief Fiscal Officer of the county. Handles property valuations, tax calculations, warrants, bookkeeping, dog licenses, vendor licenses, and financial records.

County governing body. Holds title to county property, serves as sole taxing authority, controls purchasing and budgeting. Meets Mondays and Thursdays at 9am.
